english.note: Use 帶 as the all-purpose verb for taking something with you or having it on your person.

exampleSentences.english: I always carry an umbrella when I go out.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ceot1 gaai1 jat1 ding6 daai3 ze1

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for carrying or bringing something, including carrying weapons or symbols.

exampleSentences.english: They bear arms while serving in the military.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢哋服兵役嗰陣會帶武器。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 fuk6 bing1 jik6 go2 zan6 wui5 daai3 mou5 hei3
